title: KMS key rotation canary + dual-write secrets migration Terraform module
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description:
Problem: Private (VPC) customers require a safe, auditable path to rotate or rekey KMS-backed keys (HSM or cloud KMS) without downtime for in-use secrets. We also need an automated Terraform-first module to support a coordinated dual-write migration path for customers using Vault or a Secrets Manager (e.g., AWS Secrets Manager) so operators can write to both stores during an upgrade/migration window and reconcile differences.

Scope: deliver a Terraform module plus operator-friendly runbook and health-check hooks that enable: (1) canary KMS key rotations (a subset of services use the new key initially), (2) dual-write secret adapters for Vault <-> SecretsManager to support cutover, (3) drift detection & reconciliation, (4) liveness/readiness probes and Terraform hooks for safe rolling upgrades. This ticket covers the module code, integration tests, runbook, and a small canary rollout in staging.

Non-goals: this ticket does not replace full Vault migrations, does not implement a proprietary secrets store, and does not change customer key material policies. Long-term: feed telemetry into Optimize to quantify cost/latency impact of rotations and dual-write traffic.
acceptance_criteria: A Terraform module exists (registry-style) that can provision: KMS key binding objects, optional HSM connector stubs, dual-write flagging for secrets write endpoints, and healthcheck probes exposed to the Console.
Module exposes lifecycle hooks: pre-rotation validation, canary assignment (list of service IDs), post-rotation reconciliation and rollback triggers.
Operator toolkit (scripts + Terraform example) to perform a staged canary rotation in staging with minimal downtime and documented roll-forward/rollback steps.
Dual-write adapter runs in staging and demonstrates: writes to both Vault and AWS Secrets Manager under a feature-flag, reconciliation job reports and fixes drift within 15 minutes in test scenarios.
End-to-end automated tests (CI) that simulate failed rotation, reconciliation success, and forced rollback; PRs merge only when tests pass.
Runbook and monitoring dashboard links added to the ticket and Console (alerts for key mismatch, reconciliation failure, and high error-rate during canary).
tasks: Design API surface for the Terraform module: inputs/outputs, feature flags, canary service selector (labels or route IDs).
Implement module skeleton and examples: modules/kms-rotation-canary, modules/dual-write-adapter (Vault<>SM).
Add healthcheck endpoints for operator to query key binding health and reconciliation status.
Build reconciliation job (k8s CronJob + Terraform example policy) that compares secrets metadata and queues repairs.
Write e2e tests that deploy module into staging, perform rotation for 3 services (one canary + two gradual), and validate no data loss.
Create runbook and Terraform upgrade hook examples for safe rolling upgrades (pre-checks, pre-backup, drain, rotate, verify, un-drain).
Open GitHub PRs and request security review; address any feedback from cryptography team.
Coordinate with Solutions Eng to run a controlled migration with a willing customer in a non-prod environment.
